name: document-to-markdown
title: PDF & Document to Markdown: Word, PPTX, Excel, EPUB for RAG
description: Convert PDF, Word (DOCX), PowerPoint (PPTX), Excel (XLSX), HTML and EPUB files from URLs or uploads to Markdown, plain text or RAG chunks with page numbers. Tables become Markdown tables; scanned PDFs are OCR'd. No API key or LLM. $4 per 1,000 documents.
